questions.question: State the theorem for existence and uniqueness of solutions of an initial value problem. 2F16 f(x) = − 10x2 . LU A = .20 03 Questions
questions.solution_html:
• Existence and uniqueness theorem.
  • We assume thatf(t,u)satisfies the following conditions
  • (i)f(t,u)is a real-valued function.
  • (ii)f(t,u)is defined and continuous in the strip
  • t∈[t 0,b], u∈(−∞,∞).
  • (iii) There exists a constantLsuch that for anyt∈[t 0,b]and anyu 1,u 2
  • |f(t,u 1)−f(t,u 2)|≤L|u 1−u 2|
  • whereLis called theLipschitz constant.
  • Then, for any initial valueu 0, the initial value problem has a unique solutionu(t)fort∈[t 0,b].

questions.final_answer: Then, for any initial valueu 0, the initial value problem has a unique solutionu(t)fort∈[t 0,b].
